items.difficulty_reason: The proof is the flat base change identification of every cohomology group H^i(X_{k'}, F') = H^i(X, F)  tensor _k k', whose dimensions therefore agree; summing the alternating dimensions gives chi(X, F) = chi(X', F'). H2: one named lemma with the displayed equation; the conclusion is the alternating sum of the identified groups.
